scope: single-run four-route controlled-mutation reviewer comparison; not production adjudication, not evaluator selection and not yet a translation-origin factorial

services: Anthropic first-party via Claude Code CLI
Z.ai CN via Pi custom provider
authorization.basis: The user explicitly retired Fable/Advisor for budget reasons, requested agy + Gemini 3.7 Flash, and instructed the research to begin the next experiment.
authorization.data_scope: 24 sanitized source/target/fixed-context reviewer records from the existing ToME4 translation-review corpus; no credentials, historical findings, verdicts, model provenance or local absolute paths are sent

route_policy.historical_artifact_policy: Retired-route RAW and results remain in their completed experiment and are not deleted or silently recomputed.

input.absolute_path_sanitization: Only known local repository prefixes in fixed_context are mechanically removed; generation fails on remaining /home/ or /Users/ paths.

sealed_reference.semantic_scope: injection records, not a claim that all unmodified controls are naturally defect-free

output_schema.enforcement: CLI schema where supported plus exact-order local validation

routes.advisor: disabled by safe-mode and project,local-only setting sources
routes.runtime_identity_rule: the complete task must initialize and emit assistant messages as claude-opus-5 with no fallback

routes.availability_check: agy models listed gemini-3.7-flash-high immediately before freezing

preregistered_analysis.primary: mutation-specific detection recall: a non-OK response counts only when its atomic claim matches the sealed injected mutation
secondary: source-adjudicated natural findings or false positives on controls
non-mutation findings on mutated items reported separately
union, consensus and unique confirmed mutation detections
not_allowed: count every non-OK mutant response as a hit without atomic-claim matching
count every unmodified-control finding as a false positive without source adjudication
expose REFERENCE.json or other route outputs before all independent runs complete
infer prose quality, production fitness or variance from one run
preregistered_analysis.next_gate: Only if this mutation benchmark is informative should the study pay for a reviewer-by-translation-origin factorial.
